'''Roskom Mechanized Systems''' was a maintenance contractor of the [[Glare Peak]] [[Trivar II Imperial Detention Center|detention center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trivar II/Legends|Trivar II]]. It was owned by [[Olom Roskom]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Rescue at Glare Peak">''[[Rescue at Glare Peak]]''</ref>
